summary: Re-verified all recent TeeBox changes end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in test_iter30_recent_features.py — location-first sort on /api/discover/courses + /api/courses/search, /api/discover/courses/nearby returns results sorted asc by distance (all within radius) with pydantic 422 on out-of-range coords, /api/courses/{name} returns holes/tees for Pebble Beach, White Pines no-collision, extrapolated AVG remains in sensible 18-hole range, POST /api/rounds accepts holes_played=9 + nine=front/back (invalid 'middle' 422'd), PATCH /api/auth/me home_course set+clear works. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844 mobile viewport, live web preview): (a) Discover tab search 'Pebble Beach' returns 2 course rows via location-first sort, tapping row navigates to course detail with 'Set as home course' HomeCourseButton pill next to 'Add to wishlist'; tapping the button toggles the label to 'Home course' as expected. (b) Log tab: default is Round + 18 holes; switching Holes to 9 reveals 'Which nine?' Front 9 / Back 9 selector, auto-Par updates (36 for Front 9), Save-round button is fully clickable and NOT overlapped by the bottom tab bar (iter28 critical bug is fixed; document.elementFromPoint at button center resolves to testID='log-submit'). Switching post-type to LFG correctly hides the Photos section (no 'Add photo' button rendered, no 'Photos (0/3)' label). (c) Profile Edit (via My Profile → Edit): Display name, Handicap, Home course, and Bio are all pre-populated correctly (Reese Callahan / 8.4 / Pebble Beach Golf Course / Weekend warrior…). Home course field is a CourseAutocomplete dropdown (placeholder 'Search for your home course…'); typing 'Peb' surfaces a live dropdown with 6+ real course suggestions (Cimarron Golf Club Pebble Par 3, Creekside At Pebble Creek CC, Eagles Nest CC At Pebble C…, Pebble Beach Golf Course, Pebble Beach Golf Links, Pebble Brook GC) and selecting one flips the field to a compact chip with a green 'Course selected' indicator. (d) Profile page shows AVG=81 for reese, which is the correctly extrapolated (82+79+82)/3 value from 2×18-hole rounds and 1×9-hole 41 extrapolated to 82. No blocking bugs found. One minor observation logged below.
critical_code_review_comments: app/profile/edit.tsx (line 30-35) initializes local state with useState(user?.display_name || '') etc. and has NO useEffect to re-sync when the useAuth() user object is populated after initial render. Works fine via normal navigation (My Profile → Edit) because user is already in memory, but a deep-link/hard-refresh directly to /profile/edit before /auth/me resolves leaves Display name / Handicap / Home course / Bio all empty (avatar initials fall back to 'G'). If the user then taps Save with just a home_course change, they will overwrite display_name='' etc. Recommended: add useEffect([user], () => { setDisplayName(user?.display_name || ''); setHomeCourse(user?.home_course || ''); ... }) to keep local state in sync when user finally loads. Not blocking for the tested feature set — flagging for awareness only.

CourseAutocomplete suggestion rows do not carry testID attributes (e.g. `course-suggestion-<name>`) — only the container input has testID='profile-edit-home-input'. This made automated dropdown-item selection require a text-based fallback. Non-functional issue; would improve future test stability if each suggestion Pressable had a testID.

log.tsx form now uses paddingBottom: 220 (up from 140) which fully resolves iter28's Save-round-button/tab-bar overlap bug even in the tallest form state (Round + 9 holes + Which-nine + course selected). CourseFactSheet.tsx correctly applies nativeNine = num_holes===9 guard (lines 77-81) hiding the fabricated Back9 for real 9-hole courses (iter28 secondary bug fixed).

discover_courses_nearby (routers/courses.py:344-444) correctly sorts by haversine distance ascending, enforces radius_km cap, and falls back to OpenGolfAPI's live geo-radius search when local coverage is sparse, backfilling external_id/par onto pre-existing docs via $setOnInsert dedup — behavior consistent with the location-first-sort described in the review request.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. TEST_-prefixed 9-hole test rounds (Front 9 41, Back 9 42) were created and deleted within the same test class. reese's home_course was set to 'Pebble Beach Golf Course' during frontend testing (still set on the account after this run so profile page shows the home-course chip). Cleared back to empty during backend pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review-request features (OpenGolfAPI course detail, location-first course sort in Discover + autocomplete, /nearby endpoint, 9-hole Front/Back selector on Log tab, LFG post-type photo-hidden, HomeCourseButton pill on course detail, CourseAutocomplete dropdown on Edit Profile 'Home course', extrapolated 18-hole-equivalent Profile AVG, White Pines dedup) are fully verified working at both API (pytest) and mobile-viewport UI (Playwright) level. Both previously-reported iter28 bugs (Save-round button tab-bar overlap when Holes=9; fake Back9 for native-9 courses in CourseFactSheet) are fixed and confirmed. Only note for next agent: app/profile/edit.tsx does not re-sync local useState when useAuth().user loads later — deep-linking directly to /profile/edit before the auth session hydrates shows empty fields, but every user-visible entry point (Profile → Edit) works correctly. Not fixed this iteration since it's out of scope for the listed features.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found for the reviewed features. Prior iter28 issues previously reported are confirmed fixed.
